messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

message.content: Græbrók, a name that evokes great joy, was the first stop when the family set off on a journey around the country, where each place was more beautiful than the last—waterfalls, lakes, and streams, our Icelandic plants, blueberries, crowberries, and bilberries throughout the land, fresh and icy water and hot water, natural hot springs and beautiful bathing places throughout the country, fresh air, being with the family in wonderful nature throughout the country, peace, good food and......
